name: wonder
quote: Everyone was talking about what happened in the movie.
description: A sensation that challenges your inner model of the world in a non-threatening way.

variations.name: wonder of nature
variations.description: A sense of fascination about plants or animals.

variations.name: inspirational wonder
variations.description: An inspiring sense of amazement about something that opens possibilities in your mind.
examples: I had no idea that was possible!

commentaries.quote: Nature and history are infinitely layered tapestries of wonder and terror.
If our religion is based on salvation, our chief emotions will be fear and trembling. If our religion is based on wonder, our chief emotion will be gratitude.
The moment one gives close attention to anything, even a blade of grass, it becomes a mysterious, awesome, indescribably magnificent world in itself.

conditions: A perception that challenges your inner model of the world in a non-threatening way.
